purpose: User-side acquisition of actual fixed Sanger GDSC 8.4 tables, the paper TarKG node lookup input and 81 exact LinkedOmics/TCGA files. No matrix values are bundled by this manifest.
historical_release_terms_status: The original release-specific public redistribution license has not been independently recovered. The current Sanger page describes research use; it is recorded for reference, not asserted to prove the 2022 release terms. Download and local processing do not assign an MIT license to the source tables.

entries.verification: Official HEAD HTTP 200; ETag is recorded as a publisher integrity value. fetch_native_sources.py additionally compares MD5 with the single-part hexadecimal ETag and writes a local SHA-256 receipt.

entries.release: Official static object last modified 2024-06-27; paper local archive
entries.link_provenance: Official site assets/index-tFaimE4R.js imports assets/Download-BEDIYmTn.js; this published download component explicitly lists /download/KG_Data/TarKG_nodes.csv.
entries.verification: Official HEAD200 matches archived byte count; first and last 65536-byte HTTP206 ranges match the local archive. SHA-256/MD5 are pinned from the complete archived paper input, not represented as a complete new remote download.
entries.tls: Default certificate validation remains enabled. During the 2026-10-27 audit the official certificate was expired; use --local-file or explicit --allow-legacy-tarkg-tls for this fixed URL only. The exception rejects redirects, carries no credentials and verifies the pinned full-file SHA-256 before installation.
entries.data_license_status: The official download README describes provenance and reuse but specifies no independent blanket dataset license. Preserve upstream attribution and component terms; the article open-access license is not assumed to relicense all integrated data.
